T02.objective: Implement strict story readers and read-only upstream-compatible project inspector

acceptance.text: Valid current upstream projects produce matching derived phase, approval, claims, sprint, worktree and handoff state against unchanged pinned inspector.
Strict story parsing preserves exact ordered criterion text and substantive contract hash while precisely separating Execution metadata; unsafe or duplicate sections fail.
Inspection handles malformed/missing/FIFO/symlink inputs and missing identity without mutation, hangs or false completion, and pm status exposes it without breaking legacy reads.

T06.objective: Complete native planning operations, scale policies and project artifact templates

acceptance.text: Installed skill discovers every approved high-level operation with arguments, output and write authority and only loads relevant references.
Current templates preserve stable requirement IDs, clarify blocking unknowns, produce ready unclaimed stories, and implement independent project scale and execution mode policies.
Entry remains below context budget, every operation and asset path resolves, no Claude plugin-root or slash-registration assumptions survive, and plan grants standing PM Git/PR authority.

T07.objective: Implement read-only artifact analysis, claim readiness contract and evidence-based quality checklist assets

acceptance.text: Read-only deterministic analysis reports located clarification, requirement coverage, dependency, scope, command and declared lens defects against production artifact templates; input errors never become PASS.

Analysis separates factual findings from semantic review still needed, exports claim readiness for applicable scales, and preserves files and project state even on malformed, unsafe or nonregular inputs.

Four packaged quality checklist templates and native governance instructions preserve evidence-only checkoffs, read-only analysis, scale requirements, and explicit remediation without silently changing artifacts.

T03.objective: Bind current shared approval and story claims to every runtime evidence operation while preserving legacy reads

acceptance.text: Current-format pending, approved and revoked markers use tracked regular plans and exact Git digests; authorized current claims preserve the exact story contract, actor, route and branch without mutating foreign work.

Runtime start/check/gate/review/verify/finish require current shared approval and ownership; standalone Quick cannot bypass recognized shared projects, and changed plans, routes, claims or branches invalidate continuation.

Duplicate runs and claim/resume cannot reset spent retries or fixes, unavailable explicit builder routes fail without fallback, current state is default for new projects, and legacy reads and original compatibility regressions remain supported.

T04.objective: Add durable coordinator Execution transitions and audited two-phase commit adoption without resetting cumulative scope or budgets

acceptance.text: Coordinator transitions enforce legal Execution states and persist monotonic retry/fix counters before dispatch; conflict-aware recovery preserves spent attempts and never overwrites changed story contracts.

Prepared commit adoption checks direct-parent HEAD, exact intended tree/index/branch and protected Git metadata, permits only previously audited scoped edits, and leaves original scope and dirty-work baseline immutable.

Real temporary Git repo lifecycle tests cover build, authorized commit, fresh gates/review/verification, fix and fresh-process recovery; stale PASS, unauthorized commits and bookkeeping-hidden source/contract/receipt changes cannot pass.

T05.objective: Reconcile verified local or remote integration and write upstream-compatible merged Execution and BASE_COMMIT handoffs

acceptance.text: Finish alone leaves claims active; merged Execution is recorded only after checking the real integration commit/tree against fresh verified evidence, retaining identity, criteria and spent counters.

Both current upstream/Codex story-boundary directions and fresh-process interruption/resume pass against unchanged pinned reader; handoff BASE_COMMIT matches the recorded integration and tolerates its own handoff-only commit.

PM remote adapter pushes scoped branches, creates/updates PRs and merges only exact verified heads with passing required checks under standing authorization; fake remote tests cover missing auth, pending/failure, races and merge result mismatch without real remote/model calls.

T08.objective: Unify phase-aware resume, read-only doctor/hooks and current-scale first-claim readiness without resetting state

acceptance.text: Fresh-process resume uses shared inspector to select correct phase/story or report ambiguity; approval drift, stale claims, missing evidence/worktrees and older missing retrospectives remain visible without edits.

Doctor and optional context hook perform bounded read-only checks with located OK/MISSING/DRIFT/UNKNOWN output, including environment/gates/roles/configuration; malformed hook input and absent hooks do not affect workflow.

Material correction revokes shared approval and retains spent budgets, while applicable-scale first claims require current artifact analysis and explicit semantic review; seeded blocking findings prevent claim without creating state or treating regex scans as semantic PASS.

T09.objective: Preview and apply explicit conflict-aware migration from legacy tmp/flat/actor PM formats while preserving historical evidence and spent budgets

acceptance.text: Read-only preview inventories integration and open-story branch evidence for legacy tmp, flat and actor formats, proposes exact writes/removals, retains original criteria/teammates/terminal evidence, and uses maximum credible spent counters.

Ambiguous identities/routes/status or changed before-images block apply without guessing; current+legacy drift remains explicit; approval digest follows authorized plan edits, and PASS alone cannot become merged.

Apply uses recoverable before-image journal, preserves unknown/untracked/uncommitted legacy history and old runtime receipts as history, supports safe interrupted recovery and idempotent reruns, and requires new evidence after active-run rebind.

T10.objective: Require evidence-based completed-sprint retrospectives and explicit carried-over findings

acceptance.text: Retrospective preparation requires a completed sprint and real bounded integration range, asks the upstream three questions from actual evidence, and handles unavailable history as UNKNOWN.
Retrospective records preserve carried-over work and major findings as explicit follow-up stories; AGENTS.md changes are proposed as a diff and never silently applied.
Tiny/small skip mandatory retrospectives; nonregular records never count; incomplete sprints fail without mutation and oldest missing retrospective remains first in inspector.

T11.objective: Complete native knowledge/research/review/advice operations with honest review finding adaptation

acceptance.text: Knowledge references and wiki templates preserve upstream schema, authoritative source links and superseded decisions; research uses primary citations and read-only operations never update project state.

Review scopes recent/worktree/branch/codebase produce the actual bounded intended diff with explicit integration base; risks select integrity plus applicable architecture/security lenses and retain extra lenses discovered in the diff.
Native advice remains bounded and read-only; upstream CONCERNS maps to retained minor findings, and optional external review remains tool-less/explicit with no gate-execution claims.

T12.objective: Support independent shared-story worktrees, collision checks, serial integration and interruption recovery

acceptance.text: Parallel readiness blocks unresolved dependencies, conflicting bounded touches and crossed ownership; each story keeps separate branch/worktree/evidence and whole-wave checks precede dispatch.

Two independent stories complete and integrate serially with unchanged sibling receipts while changed integration content requires fresh evidence; fresh-process recovery reports each story state without budget resets.

Failed/dirty worktrees remain intact, cleanup is clean-only and explicit, remote claim visibility is honest, and upstream external-runner shared-ref timing constraints remain documented separately from native behavior.

T13B.objective: Execute two explicitly selected native builder comparisons from the same approved story/base in isolated preserved worktrees with fake adapter tests

acceptance.text: Comparison validates two distinct explicit available native configurations before mutation and builds both from the same approved story/base in isolated worktrees, never rewriting the persisted route or silently substituting a model.

Workflow records actual first-pass gates, review findings, independent benchmark retries, elapsed time and exposed/null measurements in the T13A schema, with deterministic scoring and no automatic merge or route selection.

Fake adapters exercise both configurations including failure/retry, dirty-worktree preservation and restart evidence; no test calls real models/remotes, and optional external-builder pairing remains honestly unavailable unless explicitly configured.

T14.objective: Package and document verified upstream parity with truthful evidence matrix, preserved setup upgrades and an installed end-to-end example

acceptance.text: Every implemented operation/module/template is present in installed package and all references resolve; default current progress guidance replaces active 0.22 guidance, customized setup files remain preserved and explicit upgrade instructions are accurate.

Capability evidence matrix reports actual deterministic/model-reviewed/model-exercised evidence and deliberate provider/platform limitations without presenting fixtures as live trials or unmeasured efficiency as fact.

Worked standard example and complete test/validation evidence support planning, approval, build, review, distinct verification, resume, integration, handoff and retrospective; release diff receives final independent review and distinct verification.
